items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yeah, that was during Lindsay's administration.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a summer class out there. That was during the days when they were, what was it called, keeping down the hot summer with the riots and stuff, and they -- we went out there to teach. They practically donated a building to us.
Oh, yeah, that was during Lindsay's administration.
